experiment_template.research_question: Does exact-generation event-derived state improve native evidence selection after real recycling without speculative tokenizer work?
stop_conditions: Any projection measurement lacks a matching selected render generation.
Any state fact lacks task, receipt, or tool-event provenance.
Shared provider or instrument failure pauses unstarted cells.

records.falsifier: Any unused future-generation projection is measured, any generation-zero request includes state, no post-recycle request receives state, source/effect integrity changes, or the frozen paired native target is not met.
records.mechanism: Await rendering at the recycler boundary. Build and tokenizer-measure state only after the recycler chooses the actual generation, expose nothing at generation zero, and bind the exact measured projection into the successful request.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; exact-generation post-recycle state with structured terminal submission common.
records.statement: An event-derived task-state projection constructed only at the recycler-selected generation improves useful completion without speculative measurement.

records.research_question: Does exact-generation event-derived state improve native evidence selection after real recycling without speculative tokenizer work?
stop_conditions: Any unused-generation state measurement or unmatched presentation is an instrument failure.
No acceptance or successor selection changes from observed outcomes.
No within-round changes, replacements, source refresh, threshold changes or lucky reruns.
Pause unstarted cells on shared provider or instrument failure and retain every attempted outcome.

success_criteria.scope: Eight exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K exact-generation development pairs; no full cohort, larger window, confirmation, repair correctness, transfer or clearance claim.

records.claim: Exact-generation state reached four treatment requests with zero speculative measurements, then exceeded its fixed state-token cap and degraded valid completion relative to the matched control.
limitations: One task cannot estimate average quality.
The result tests H13 completion and bounding behavior, not semantic utility after a completed treatment episode.

records.next_action: Retain exact-generation rendering and fit the newest receipt-bound state facts deterministically under the measured tokenizer cap before each post-recycle model request.
